summary: This is the exact API reference for Sonner, the React toast library, taken from the ask-sonner skill in the emilkowalski/skills repository. It lists every prop of the <Toaster /> component and every option of the toast() function, with types and defaults, plus the helper functions for typed, loading, promise, custom and dismissed toasts. The defaults form a concrete, value-level spec for a notification component: 3 visible toasts, bottom-right placement, a 32px screen offset (16px under 600px wide), a 14 gap when expanded, 4000 ms auto-close, an Alt+T hotkey and a 'Notifications' ARIA label. It also defines the override model (per-toast options beat Toaster-wide toastOptions) and how update-by-id, headless rendering and multiple toasters work. For a design system it gives the exact knobs a toast component should expose and the default values to start from.
key_ideas: Options passed to a single toast() call override the same options set on the Toaster through toastOptions.
The <Toaster /> holds global behavior: theme, position, offsets, number of visible toasts, gap, hotkey, icons and default toast options.
toast() returns the toast's id, and calling toast() again with the same id updates that toast instead of adding a new one.
A toast auto-closes after 4000 ms by default; duration Infinity keeps it on screen.
By default toasts expand on hover; expand: true shows them expanded by default.
Only 3 toasts are visible at once by default.
Offsets differ by screen size: 32px from the edges normally, 16px when the screen is narrower than 600px, and each side can be set separately.
Swipe-to-dismiss directions follow the toaster's position unless swipeDirections overrides them.
Keyboard and ARIA hooks come with defaults: the ⌥/alt + T hotkey focuses the toaster area and the container's ARIA label is 'Notifications'.
Status toasts (success, error, info, warning) get matching icons; richColors makes success and error more colorful.
Clicking the action button closes the toast unless its onClick calls event.preventDefault(); clicking the secondary cancel button closes the toast.
Class names on toast parts need !important unless the toast is unstyled.
toast.custom() is headless: your JSX with Sonner's behavior.
onDismiss (close button or swipe) and onAutoClose (duration ran out) are separate callbacks.
Several toasters can coexist: each gets an id, and toasterId sends a toast to one of them.
toast(message, options) takes a string, JSX, or a function returning JSX as the message, and returns the toast's id.
Setting an icon to null removes it, per type in the Toaster's icons object or per toast with icon.

rules.rule: Put app-wide toast defaults in the Toaster's toastOptions and override them per toast() call; per-call options win over toastOptions.
rules.why: Options passed to toast() override the same options set via the Toaster's toastOptions.
rules.evidence: Options passed to `toast()` override the same options set via the Toaster's `toastOptions`

rules.rule: Set the Toaster's theme to 'light', 'dark' or 'system'; it defaults to 'light'.
rules.why: The API reference lists theme as 'light', 'dark' or 'system' with 'light' as the default; it states no recommendation (the dark-mode fix is a rule in the sibling SKILL.md).

rules.rule: Turn on richColors when success and error toasts must read as colored states rather than neutral ones.
rules.why: richColors makes error and success states more colorful; it is off by default.
rules.evidence: Makes error and success states more colorful.

rules.rule: Set expand on the Toaster to show toasts expanded by default; left at its default (false), toasts expand on hover.
rules.why: The API reference documents expand as a boolean defaulting to false: toasts expanded by default, otherwise they expand on hover. It states no recommendation.
rules.evidence: Toasts expanded by default (otherwise they expand on hover)

rules.rule: Show at most 3 toasts at once by default (visibleToasts).
rules.why: Sonner's documented default amount of visible toasts is 3 [inferred: adopted as house default].

rules.rule: Place toasts bottom-right by default, choosing only from top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center or bottom-right.
rules.why: bottom-right is the documented default position and these are the six supported positions [inferred: adopted as house default].

rules.rule: Offset the toaster 32px from the screen edges on desktop.
rules.why: The default offset from screen edges is '32px' [inferred: adopted as house default].

rules.rule: Use a smaller 16px edge offset when the screen is narrower than 600px (mobileOffset).
rules.why: mobileOffset is the offset used when screen width < 600px and defaults to '16px' [inferred: adopted as house default].

rules.rule: When one edge needs a different distance, pass the offset as a per-side object instead of a single value.
rules.why: The object form of offset is per-side.

rules.rule: Let swipe-to-dismiss directions follow the toaster position, and set swipeDirections only when they must differ.
rules.why: swipeDirections defaults to directions based on position [inferred: adopted as house default].

rules.rule: Set dir to match the app's text direction (default 'ltr') [inferred].
rules.why: dir controls text directionality and defaults to 'ltr'.

rules.rule: Keep a keyboard shortcut that moves focus to the toaster area, Alt+T by default.
rules.why: hotkey is the keyboard shortcut that focuses the toaster area, default ⌥/alt + T [keeping it enabled is inferred].
rules.evidence: Keyboard shortcut that focuses the toaster area.

rules.rule: Use invert (Toaster-wide or per toast) to show dark toasts in light mode and light toasts in dark mode.
rules.why: invert gives dark toasts in light mode and vice versa; default false.
rules.evidence: Dark toasts in light mode and vice versa.

rules.rule: Space expanded toasts with a gap of 14 by default.
rules.why: gap is the gap between toasts when expanded and defaults to 14 [inferred: adopted as house default].

rules.rule: Replace status icons for the whole system through the Toaster's icons object (success, info, warning, error, loading), and use null to remove one.
rules.why: icons replaces default icons per type; null removes one.

rules.rule: Add a close button to all toasts with closeButton on the Toaster, or to one toast with closeButton in toast(); it is off by default.
rules.why: closeButton adds a close button and defaults to false at both levels.
rules.evidence: Adds a close button to all toasts.

rules.rule: Auto-close toasts after 4000 ms by default.
rules.why: duration is the milliseconds before auto-close and defaults to 4000 [inferred: adopted as house default].

rules.rule: Use duration: Infinity to keep a toast on screen until it is dismissed.
rules.why: Infinity persists the toast.

rules.rule: Leave toasts dismissible by the user; set dismissible: false only when the user must not be able to close it.
rules.why: dismissible defaults to true; if false, the user cannot dismiss the toast [inferred: keeping the default as house default].
rules.evidence: If `false`, the user cannot dismiss the toast.

rules.rule: Pass icon: null on a toast to remove its default icon, or a ReactNode to replace it.
rules.why: icon renders in front of the text; null removes the default.
rules.evidence: Icon in front of the text

rules.rule: Give a toast a primary action via action ({ label, onClick } or a ReactNode); clicking it closes the toast, so call event.preventDefault() in onClick when the toast must stay open.
rules.why: Clicking the action closes the toast unless onClick calls event.preventDefault().
rules.evidence: Primary button; clicking closes the toast unless `onClick` calls `event.preventDefault()`

rules.rule: Use cancel ({ label, onClick } or a ReactNode) for the secondary button; clicking it closes the toast.
rules.why: cancel is the secondary button and clicking it closes the toast.
rules.evidence: Secondary button; clicking closes the toast.

rules.rule: Style the action and cancel buttons through actionButtonStyle and cancelButtonStyle objects.
rules.why: These options hold styles for the action and cancel buttons; both default to {}.

rules.rule: Give a toast a custom id when it will be updated later, and call toast() again with that id to update it instead of adding a new toast.
rules.why: Calling toast() again with the same id updates the existing toast.
rules.evidence: Custom id; calling `toast()` again with the same id updates the existing toast.

rules.rule: Set testId on toasts that end-to-end tests need to find; it renders as data-testid.
rules.why: testId is rendered as data-testid for e2e tests.

rules.rule: When more than one Toaster exists, give each an id and send each toast to one with toasterId.
rules.why: The Toaster id is targeted by toast()'s toasterId option.

rules.rule: Style individual toast parts with classNames (toast, title, description, actionButton, cancelButton, closeButton) and mark those classes !important unless the toast is unstyled.
rules.why: classNames need !important unless unstyled.
values: { toast, title, description, actionButton, cancelButton, closeButton }

rules.rule: Use unstyled: true to remove all default toast styles when the design system supplies its own.
rules.why: unstyled removes all default styles; default false.

rules.rule: Handle manual closes in onDismiss and timeouts in onAutoClose; they are different events.
rules.why: onDismiss fires on the close button or a swipe; onAutoClose fires when the toast closes after duration.
rules.evidence: Fires when the toast closes automatically after `duration`.

rules.rule: Keep an ARIA label on the toast container, 'Notifications' by default, and localise it with containerAriaLabel.
rules.why: containerAriaLabel is the ARIA label for the toast container and defaults to 'Notifications' [keeping and localising it is inferred].
rules.evidence: ARIA label for the toast container.

rules.rule: Use toast.success, toast.error, toast.info and toast.warning for status messages so each gets its matching icon.
rules.why: These are typed toasts with a matching icon.

rules.rule: Use toast.loading for a spinner toast and update it later by its id.
rules.why: toast.loading is a toast with a spinner that you update by id.
rules.evidence: Toast with a spinner; update it by id.

rules.rule: Use toast.promise(promise, { loading, success, error }) for async work, where success and error can be strings, JSX, functions of the result, or objects of toast options.
rules.why: It shows a loading toast that resolves with the promise.
rules.evidence: Loading toast that resolves with the promise

rules.rule: Use toast.custom((t) => jsx) when the toast's look must be fully your own but the behavior should stay Sonner's.
rules.why: toast.custom is a headless toast: your JSX, Sonner's behavior.
rules.evidence: Headless toast — your JSX, Sonner's behavior.

rules.rule: Dismiss one toast with toast.dismiss(id) and all toasts with toast.dismiss() without an id.
rules.why: toast.dismiss dismisses one toast, or all when called without an id.
rules.evidence: Dismiss one toast, or all when called without an id.

rules.rule: Read active toasts with useSonner() inside React and toast.getActiveToasts() outside React.
rules.why: useSonner returns { toasts }; getActiveToasts is usable outside React.
rules.evidence: All active toasts, usable outside React.

rules.rule: Pass a description (ReactNode or a function returning JSX) for a second line under the title.
rules.why: description renders underneath the title and accepts a function returning JSX.

rules.rule: Override one toast's placement with toast()'s position option (default 'bottom-right') when it must differ from the Toaster.
rules.why: position is also a per-toast option: the position of this toast.

rules.rule: Use style on a toast() call (or in toastOptions) for inline styles on the toast.
rules.why: style holds inline styles for the toast.

rules.rule: Pass the toast message as a string, JSX, or a function returning JSX, and keep the id toast() returns when the toast will be updated or dismissed later.
rules.why: toast(message, options) accepts those message forms and returns the toast's id; updates and toast.dismiss(id) work by id.
rules.evidence: message is a string, JSX, or a function returning JSX. Returns the toast's id

rules.rule: Use toast.promise's success and error as functions of the result (or objects of toast options) when the result toast needs the resolved value or extra options.
rules.why: success/error accept strings, JSX, functions of the result, or objects of toast options.
rules.evidence: `success`/`error` accept strings, JSX, functions of the result, or objects of toast options

caveats: This is a library reference pinned to commit 85e8e23 of emilkowalski/skills; defaults and prop names can change in later Sonner versions.
It documents React-specific APIs; the values carry over to other platforms only as design defaults, not as code.
The source lists defaults without saying why they were chosen; rules that adopt them as house defaults are marked [inferred].
Units are given as written: offsets are CSS strings ('32px', '16px') while gap is a bare number (14).
